title: A 1:40 scale model of the Red Pyramid exploded under pressure

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. And I'm sure you saw that we made a 1 to 40 scale model of the red pyramid and it completely exploded due to the pressure on the inside of this thing.

plain: A model of Egypt's ancient Red Pyramid, built at one fortieth of full size, blew apart from the pressure that built up inside it, according to Geoffrey Drumm, a man who studies what the pyramids were for and says he helped build it. Drumm says "it completely exploded due to the pressure on the inside," and he tells it as a sign that the pyramid was built as a working machine and not only as a tomb.
